headline: Trump: Kids Get Two Dolls, Not 30

beats.text: At an April thirtieth Cabinet meeting, Trump brushed off warnings that tariffs would empty store shelves by Christmas.

beats.caption: Well, maybe the children will have two dolls instead of 30 dolls, you know,
beats.label: via The White House

beats.caption: which brings me to my new segment, "Oh, Hell No." Oh, hell no!
beats.label: via Saturday Night Live

beats.text: The kicker: he immediately priced it out for you.

beats.caption: and maybe the two dolls will cost a couple of bucks more than they would normally.
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: Five days later on Meet the Press, he doubled down, math and all.

beats.caption: needs to have 30 dolls. I think they can have three or four dolls.
beats.label: via NBC News

beats.text: Cable news obliged him with a nickname that stuck.

beats.caption: Only Donny Two Dolls could think like that.
beats.label: via MSNBC

beats.text: The White House sent Stephen Miller out the next day to defend the math, but checkout aisle prices stayed exactly the same.
